patients.summary: Math teacher with ADPKD who joins on hemodialysis in 2018, receives a deceased donor kidney in December 2020, and then works through acute and chronic rejection, CMV colitis, Pneumocystis pneumonia, DKA and, in 2026, EBV-positive polymorphic PTLD treated with reduced immunosuppression and rituximab. Insulin-treated type 2 diabetes and hypertension run through the whole chart.

documents.title: New patient inquiry
documents.author: front desk
documents.body: Caller wants to establish with the practice. 43 yo M, teaches math at the high school, dialysis three days a week (M/W/F mornings before school, he says) and listed for a kidney transplant. Prior PCP retired. Membership explained, Medicare primary + BCBS secondary for outside services. New patient visit booked for after school on a non-dialysis day. Records release mailed to his nephrology group and dialysis unit.

procedures.procedure: Office visit, new patient, high MDM

documents.title: New Patient Visit
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
NEW PATIENT

43 yo man joining us; last PCP retired this summer. Polycystic kidney disease is the headline: kidneys failed and he started in-center hemodialysis about a year and a half ago, three mornings a week. Listed at the regional transplant center for a deceased donor kidney. Left native kidney was removed in 2011 for an infected cyst; right native kidney still in. Teaching full time (HS math) and determined to keep doing it.

DM2 on basal/bolus insulin, glargine 24 u qhs and lispro by a 1:12 carb ratio. Checks fingersticks before meals. Denies lows. HTN on amlodipine 10. Aspirin 81.

PMH: ADPKD, ESRD on HD, DM2, HTN
PSH: L native nephrectomy 2011 (infected cyst)
Meds: amlodipine 10 daily, ASA 81, glargine 24 u qhs, lispro 1 u/12 g carb with meals
Allergies: NKDA
FH: father with PKD, on dialysis in his 50s, died at 58 of a ruptured brain aneurysm. Mother HTN and DM2. Sister has PKD and is on hemodialysis now.
SH: smokes cigarettes daily, has tried to stop before. Alcohol 1-2 drinks a month. Lives in South Hadley.

ROS: tired on dialysis days, otherwise negative.

Exam: well-appearing. BP as recorded. HEENT nl. Neck supple, no LAD. Lungs clear. Heart RRR, no murmur. Abd soft, fullness R flank, nontender. Ext no edema. Feet: intact skin, pulses 2+, monofilament sensation intact. Skin no rashes.

A/P
1. ADPKD / ESRD on HD, transplant listed - nephrology and dialysis unit drive this. Requested their records and the transplant center's listing letter.
2. DM2 on insulin - A1c today (knowing it reads a bit unreliable with dialysis anemia). Eye exam due.
3. HTN - on amlodipine 10, BP okay for a dialysis day off.
4. Tobacco - smoking affects his transplant candidacy, he knows. Talked through quitting, counseling offered; he wants to set his own date. Will revisit each visit.
5. HM: Tdap today. HCV, HIV, HBsAg/Ab today. Flu and pneumococcal next month; hep B series if not immune. PHQ-2 0.

RTC 3 months.

events.reason: records received from nephrology and transplant center

documents.title: Nephrology records and transplant listing letter
documents.author: nephrology
documents.body:
Received from outside nephrology group, dialysis unit and regional transplant center:

Nephrology summary: autosomal dominant polycystic kidney disease with progressive loss of function, strong family history (father, sister). Left native nephrectomy in 2011 for an infected cyst. Hemodialysis initiated March 2017; in-center three times weekly, tolerating well.

Transplant center letter: evaluation complete, patient active on the deceased donor kidney waitlist. Ongoing requirements: age-appropriate cancer screening, vaccinations current, and complete abstinence from tobacco before transplant.

Meds per their list: amlodipine 10 mg daily, aspirin 81 mg daily, insulin glargine 24 units nightly, insulin lispro with meals. Allergies: NKDA.

Scanned to chart, routed to PCP.

documents.title: Vaccine visit
documents.author: RN
documents.body: Here for vaccines per PCP plan. Hep B surface antibody negative from September labs, starting 2-dose Heplisav series. Flu R deltoid, PCV13 L deltoid, Heplisav-B L deltoid lower site. Waited 15 min, no reaction. Dose 2 of hep B in 1 month, PPSV23 in 8 weeks or more.

documents.title: Heplisav-B dose 2
documents.author: RN
documents.body: Second Heplisav-B given IM R deltoid. Tolerated. Titer to be drawn in 1-2 months; will add to January visit.

procedures.procedure: Office visit, established patient, moderate MDM

documents.title: Primary Care Office Visit
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
S: f/u DM/HTN. Sept A1c reasonable. Fingersticks mostly 120s-170s, a few 200s after pizza nights. No lows. Dialysis going fine. Still smoking, has cut down some. School busy with exams.
O: vitals as charted. Lungs clear. Heart regular. No edema. Feet intact.
A/P: DM2 - A1c repeated, no change to glargine 24 / lispro ratio. HTN - fine on amlodipine. Tobacco - pushing toward a quit date before the holidays end; he'll think about it. Eye exam: gave him the optometrist list. RTC 3 mo.

documents.title: PPSV23 and titer
documents.author: RN
documents.body: PPSV23 IM L deltoid, tolerated. Hep B surface Ab drawn post-series.

documents.title: Hep B titer
documents.author: PCP
documents.body: HBsAb positive after Heplisav series - immune. Copy sent to dialysis unit.

procedures.procedure: Office visit, established patient, moderate MDM

documents.title: Primary Care Office Visit
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
Routine DM/HTN visit. Feeling okay, gets wiped out on dialysis days but teaching through it. No hypoglycemia. Down to under half a pack, he estimates, but not quit. Transplant coordinator reminded him again that smoking has to stop.

Exam: NAD, lungs clear, RRR, no edema, feet without lesions.

Plan: A1c today. Same insulin. Amlodipine 10. Tobacco: >3 min counseling, offered pharmacotherapy and quitline, he prefers to taper on his own for now. 3 months.

procedures.procedure: Office visit, established patient, moderate MDM

documents.title: Primary Care Office Visit
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
Summer break, so a morning appt for once. Glucoses steady. No complaints. Still smoking a few a day.
BP okay. Exam unchanged, no edema, feet fine.
A1c and lipids today. Continue current regimen. Urine studies not useful while essentially anuric on dialysis - skipping. Tobacco again discussed. RTC Sept for physical.

documents.title: Annual Physical
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
ANNUAL
44 yo M. ESRD from ADPKD on HD, still waitlisted. DM2, HTN.
Interval: nothing new. Optometry visit done in the spring, no retinopathy per pt (letter not yet received - requested).
Habits: smoking down to a few cigarettes, he says he'll be done by the holidays. Alcohol rare.
ROS negative.
Exam: Gen well. HEENT nl, TMs clear. Neck no LAD, no thyromegaly. Lungs clear. CV RRR no m. Abd soft, R flank fullness, NT. GU deferred. Ext no edema. Skin no suspicious lesions. Neuro grossly intact. Feet intact, monofilament nl.
Plan: labs, flu today. Colon screening not yet due (age 45 next year). PHQ-2 0. Continue meds. Tobacco: quit date set for early December.

procedures.procedure: Office visit, established patient, moderate MDM

documents.title: Primary Care Office Visit
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
Good news first - he quit. Last cigarette the first weekend of December, cold turkey, and no slips so far. Some irritability, eating more crackers. Very proud, and the transplant team is happy.

DM: sugars a little higher with the snacking but no change needed. BP fine.
Exam: lungs clear, heart regular, no edema.

A/P: tobacco dependence now in early remission - congratulated, relapse plan reviewed (call if cravings spike, NRT available). A1c today. Same insulin and amlodipine. RTC March.

procedures.procedure: Office visit, established patient, low MDM

documents.title: Primary Care Office Visit
documents.author: PCP
documents.body: Quick f/u. Still not smoking, 3 months now. Sugars okay. Dialysis unit tightening visitor rules with the new virus going around; we talked about masking, handwashing, and that he should call before coming in if sick. Exam unremarkable. A1c today. No changes. Next visit may be by video.

procedures.procedure: Telehealth visit, established patient, low MDM

documents.title: Video Visit
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
Video, pt at home, identity verified, consented. Finished the school year teaching remotely. Dialysis continuing in person. Home BPs on dialysis days per their sheets around 140s/80s. Fingersticks 110-180, no lows. Not smoking. No symptoms.
A/P: stable. Continue amlodipine, glargine 24, lispro ratio, ASA. Labs with the fall physical. Remains active on the transplant list.

documents.title: Annual Physical
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
Annual exam, masked visit.
45 yo, ADPKD/ESRD on HD, waiting on a kidney. DM2 on insulin, HTN.
Smoke-free since Dec 2019. Hybrid teaching this fall, tiring. Mood fine; PHQ-2 1 (a little low energy).
Exam: well. Lungs clear. Heart regular. Abd soft, R flank fullness. No edema. Skin clear. Feet intact.
HM: flu today. He turned 45 - discussed colon screening; with the transplant center's cancer screening requirement he'd like the stool test - FIT kit given. Labs drawn.
RTC 3 months or sooner when he gets the call.

documents.title: FIT not returned
documents.author: MA
documents.body: Called re: FIT kit from Sept physical, not returned. Pt says it's in his bathroom drawer, will mail this week.

documents.title: Got the call
documents.author: patient
documents.body: Just wanted you to know I got the call at 2am - there's a kidney. Heading to the transplant center now. Fingers crossed.

documents.title: Re: Got the call
documents.author: PCP
documents.body: Joel, wonderful news. Thinking of you today. Have the transplant team send us your discharge papers and let us know once you're home so we can set up a check-in.
